description: Source code for command-line options handling in the lu5 scripting environment, including functions for help, version, init, log, and install options, with external dependencies on filesystem, logger, and state modules.

methods.name: lu5_option_log
methods.description: Handles setting the log level based on command-line argument.

methods.name: lu5_option_init
methods.description: Creates a new lu5 sketch file, optionally overwriting existing files.

methods.name: lu5_option_install
methods.description: Installs a lu5 sketch globally, copying and setting permissions.

methods.name: lu5_option_version
methods.description: Displays the current version of lu5.

methods.name: lu5_option_help
methods.description: Displays help information for command-line options.
